title: Bollard + Post Top
headline: Replaces up to 1000W HID.
intro: Keep the look and feel of your existing fixture, while saving energy and maintenance costs. Several models feature FlexWatt and FlexColor allowing for substantial sku reduction and in-field adjustability.
callouts: LED-8000 — multiple voltage options & longer neck for a better fit

tables.title: Bollard + Post Top | Ballast Bypass | Type B | FlexWatt + FlexColor
notes: Default wattage and CCT for SuperFlex lamps are shown in bold
Three rule-separated row groups on the page: LED-8037/8038/8039 fixed-wattage FlexColor lamps; LED-8029/8024/8027/8028 FlexWatt + FlexColor lamps; LED-8075/8000 high-output FlexWatt + FlexColor lamps

tables.title: Bollard + Post Top | Ballast Bypass | Type B | Frosted-lens + filament
notes: Default lumens and CCT for FlexColor lamps are shown in bold

Two rule-separated row groups on the page: LED-8017 to LED-8021 frosted-lens FlexColor lamps (E26/EX39), and LED-8060 to LED-8065 filament-style lamps in fixed 2200K/4000K/5000K versions (part-number suffix 22/40/50); the 806x lamps have no bold defaults and carry cETLus/FCC marks instead of UL

footnotes: * Excludes 8037-39 models (applies to the Active Cooling feature)
DLC: for listing status go to LED-LLC.com
Listings icons on both pages are the cULus Listed and cULus Classified marks; the LED-806x filament lamps show the cETLus (Intertek) and FCC marks; LED-8028M345-G7-FW is marked PENDING
Page 4 printed heading for the first column is '120-277V PART #'

extras.title: Size comparison
extras.text: Smaller because size does matter. Each triplet shows the HID lamp being replaced, our retrofit (labelled OURS) and a typical competitor LED corn lamp of the same wattage class; overall lengths are marked for the HID lamp and the competitor (our lamp dimensions are in the spec table).

extras.title: Page 4 lead-in (LED-801x/802x and LED-806x)
extras.headline: Replaces up to 400W HID.
extras.text: Perfect for post-top and bollard fixtures, these retrofits feature a shape that closely mimics traditional lamp technology. 801X and 802X models feature frosted lenses for a classic lamp-like appearance.
